landing.faq1A: We are onboarding companies from the waitlist in small groups. Join, and we'll email you when your access is ready. Your two-week free trial starts then.
landing.faq2Q: Does Licits submit offers for me?
landing.faq2A: No. Licits finds, checks and drafts. You review everything and submit on SEAP yourself.
landing.faq3Q: How does it know which tenders I can win?
landing.faq3A: It compares every requirement with your company file and looks at the buyer's past awards: who won, and with what offer.
landing.faq4Q: Where does the data come from?
landing.faq4A: From SEAP (e-licitatie.ro), the official Romanian public procurement platform, including the award notices of past tenders.
landing.faq5A: Plans start at 199 RON a month plus VAT. Everyone on the waitlist gets the first two weeks free on any plan.

landing.m_discIntro: SEAP publishes hundreds of notices a day, most with long legal titles. Licits reads them for you, keeps the ones that match your company and rewrites each title so you know in one line what is being bought.
landing.m_discS1Body: New notices are fetched from e-licitatie.ro several times a day, with the documents attached to them.
landing.m_discS2Body: Your CPV codes, counties, value range and procedure types decide what reaches your feed. Words you exclude never show up.
landing.m_discS3Body: AI shortens each official title and summarises what the authority wants, so you can decide in seconds.
landing.m_eligIntro: Eligibility is where most bids fail. Licits extracts each requirement from the fișa de date, even from scanned PDFs, and compares it with your company file using exact numbers instead of guesses.
landing.m_eligS1Body: Turnover, similar works, certificates and guarantees are read from the tender documents. Scanned pages are read with OCR.
landing.m_eligS2Body: Each threshold is checked against the figures in your company profile, one requirement at a time.
landing.m_eligS3Body: Met, not met, or couldn't verify. When the file is unclear, Licits says so instead of guessing.
landing.mEligLine: Cifra de afaceri medie anuală pe ultimii 3 ani: minimum 6.000.000 lei
landing.mEligReqLine: Average turnover, last 3 years: at least RON 6,000,000
landing.m_genIntro: Writing an offer from a blank page takes days. Licits's five agents each own one part of the work and sign what they write, so you can see where every section came from and change it.
landing.m_genS1Body: Certificates, past contracts and company data you uploaded become the evidence in the draft.
landing.m_genS2Body: The spec analyst, eligibility checker, legal reviewer, writer and risk assessor each label their sections.
landing.m_genS3Body: Edit any section, ask AI to revise a passage, then export to PDF. Nothing is submitted for you.

landing.m_mktIntro: Knowing the incumbent changes how you bid. Licits reads past award notices to show which firms a buyer has chosen in your CPV group, and spots contracts that are tendered on a regular cycle.
landing.m_mktS1Body: Award notices show who won, for how much and how often, in each CPV group.
landing.m_mktS2Body: See whether one firm keeps winning or whether the field is open.
landing.m_mktS3Body: Recurring contracts are spotted from their history, so you can prepare before the notice is published.
landing.mMktNote: This contract was awarded every two years, each time in spring. The next tender is likely around March 2027.

landing.faq6A: For now, yes. We start with construction works (CPV 45), so every check fits the trade: similar works, equipment, staff, turnover and guarantees. Other sectors come later.
landing.audEyebrow: For firms new to public tenders
landing.audTitle: New to public tenders? Start with the ones you can win.
landing.audSub: Most first-time bidders lose weeks on tenders they were never going to qualify for. Licits checks every construction notice against your company first.
landing.aud1Body: See which tenders fit your size, authorizations and references, and what you would need for the rest, such as a partner or a guarantee.
landing.aud2Body: Keep the know-how in your own team. Every check shows its reason, so you learn the rules instead of paying for each screening.
landing.aud3Body: Stop reading notices one by one. Get the few that match, with the requirements already compared, and draft the offer from your documents.

about.titleA: Public works go to the firms
about.intro: Licits is built for Romanian construction companies. It reads every SEAP notice for works, shows which ones you can win, and drafts the offer with you.
about.nameBody: From licitație, a tender. Licits means tenders: the name says what we do.
about.why1: Thousands of notices reach SEAP every week, written in dense procurement language. Large contractors have bid teams. A small contractor has a site to run, and reads tenders in the evening, if at all.
about.why2: So the problem is rarely losing a tender. It is never seeing the right one in time, or not knowing early enough whether you qualify. We built Licits to close that gap.
about.b1Body: Roads, schools, bridges, insulation, sewers. We speak the language of works: CPV codes, authorizations, classes, similar contracts.
about.b2Body: Every match shows the requirement, your figure and why it passes or fails. No black-box scores.
about.b3Body: Licits prepares, you decide. We never submit for you: you review everything and submit on SEAP yourself.
about.b4Body: Every notice comes from SEAP and links back to it. We add clarity, not a new place to look.
about.s1Body: CUI, CAEN codes, authorizations, turnover and references. Most of it fills in from public records and your documents.
about.s2Body: New works notices are matched to your profile and checked requirement by requirement, in plain words.
about.s3Body: For the tenders worth your time, Licits drafts the offer and DUAE from your own documents. You review and submit.
about.ctaTitle: Ready to see the tenders you can win?
about.ctaBody: We are onboarding construction companies from the waitlist in small groups, with two weeks free.
